svg.aria-label: Data Pilot deploy topology: a visitor with no login reaches the React SPA on CloudFront and S3, which calls one App Runner backend instance, which reads Aurora Serverless v2 where row-level security is enforced; ECS Fargate one-shot jobs stream the full CSVs from S3 to rebuild the marts, and the data-agent service is not created at all in demo mode.

g.title: data-agent App Runner service — 2 vCPU / 4 GB in the full build; Terraform does not create it in demo mode, which is the single biggest cost line removed
visitor — no account, no sign-up; one click into a seeded read-only demo identity
CloudFront in front of a private S3 bucket — the Vite build of the React SPA, served over the default cloudfront.net certificate with an SPA fallback route
backend-api on App Runner — one instance, 0.25 vCPU / 512 MB, max_concurrency 100; carries the web API, the webhook, the Slack surface, MCP and the demo replay pack
S3 — the full NSW sales and rental-bond CSVs the pipeline job streams in
ECS Fargate one-shot tasks — Alembic migrations at 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB, then the dlt and dbt pipeline at 1 vCPU / 4 GB rebuilding the marts
Aurora Serverless v2 Postgres 16 with pgvector — 0 to 1 ACU, scale-to-zero; row-level security and per-role statement timeouts are enforced here, not in application code

path.title: the data-agent service is not created in demo mode

svg.text: ap-southeast-2 · Terraform · chat replayed, SQL live
